schemes.scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship to OBC Students - Maharashtra
schemes.department_name: Department of Other Backward Bahujan Welfare, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.description: Post-matric financial assistance to OBC students of Maharashtra pursuing government-approved education beyond Class X, administered through MahaDBT.
schemes.benefit_description: Maintenance allowance and reimbursement of compulsory fees as per state norms for post-matric courses.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must belong to the OBC category
rules.remedy_template: Obtain an OBC caste certificate from the Tahsildar office.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must be a Maharashtra resident
rules.remedy_template: Obtain a Maharashtra domicile certificate; this state scheme is residency-restricted.

rules.rule_description: Must be pursuing post-matric (Class X and above) education
rules.remedy_template: This scholarship covers education beyond matriculation only.

rules.rule_description: Parents/guardians must not be income-tax payers per state income limit
rules.remedy_template: Provide a valid income certificate within the state limit.

schemes.scheme_name: Tuition Fee & Exam Fee Reimbursement for OBC Girls in Professional Courses - Maharashtra
schemes.department_name: Department of Other Backward Bahujan Welfare, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.description: Full tuition and examination fee reimbursement for OBC girl students pursuing professional courses in government-approved institutions in Maharashtra.
schemes.benefit_description: 100% reimbursement of tuition fees and examination fees for eligible professional courses.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must belong to the OBC category
rules.remedy_template: Obtain an OBC caste certificate from the Tahsildar office.

rules.rule_description: Scheme is exclusively for girl students
rules.remedy_template: This fee-reimbursement scheme is only for female OBC students.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must be a Maharashtra resident
rules.remedy_template: Obtain a Maharashtra domicile certificate.

rules.rule_description: Must be enrolled in a professional degree course
rules.remedy_template: The scheme covers professional degree-level courses.

schemes.scheme_name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti (EWS/EBC) - Maharashtra
schemes.department_name: Department of Social Justice and Special Assistance, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.description: Fee reimbursement and scholarship for economically backward general-category (SEBC/EWS) students of Maharashtra admitted to eligible professional and non-professional courses.
schemes.benefit_description: Tuition-fee reimbursement up to state norms for eligible general-category students with family income up to Rs 8 lakh.

rules.rule_description: Targets the general (open/SEBC) category - reserved-category students have their own dedicated schemes
rules.remedy_template: Reserved-category students should apply under their category's post-matric scholarship.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must be a Maharashtra resident
rules.remedy_template: Obtain a Maharashtra domicile certificate.

rules.rule_description: Must be pursuing eligible higher/professional education
rules.remedy_template: The scheme covers eligible professional and non-professional courses.

rules.rule_description: Family annual income must be Rs 8,00,000 or below
rules.remedy_template: Obtain an income certificate confirming family income within Rs 8 lakh.

schemes.scheme_name: Top Class Education for SC Students
schemes.department_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
schemes.description: Central Sector Scholarship enabling SC students to pursue education beyond Class XII in notified premier institutions across India.
schemes.benefit_description: Full tuition fee support, living expenses and book/grant allowance at notified institutions.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must belong to the SC category
rules.remedy_template: Obtain an SC caste certificate from the competent authority.

rules.rule_description: Must be pursuing education beyond Class XII at a notified institution
rules.remedy_template: Admission to a notified premier institution is required (engineering is covered).

rules.rule_description: Family annual income must not exceed Rs 8 lakh (scheme ceiling)
rules.remedy_template: Provide an income certificate within the notified ceiling.

schemes.scheme_name: Top Class Education for ST Students
schemes.department_name: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India
schemes.description: National fellowship-style scholarship enabling ST students to pursue higher education at identified premier institutions such as IITs and NITs.
schemes.benefit_description: Full tuition support at identified premier institutes plus monthly living allowance and book grants.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must belong to the ST category
rules.remedy_template: Obtain an ST caste/tribe certificate from the competent authority.

rules.rule_description: Must be pursuing prescribed higher-education courses at identified premier institutes
rules.remedy_template: Admission to an identified premier institute (IIT/NIT and similar) is required.

rules.rule_description: Family annual income must be Rs 6,00,000 or below
rules.remedy_template: Provide an income certificate within the Rs 6 lakh ceiling.

schemes.scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship to ST Students - Maharashtra
schemes.department_name: Tribal Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.description: Post-matric financial assistance to ST students of Maharashtra pursuing approved courses, with income ceiling of Rs 2.5 lakh.
schemes.benefit_description: Maintenance allowance and fee reimbursement as per state norms; caste validity required for professional courses.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must belong to the ST category
rules.remedy_template: Obtain an ST caste certificate from the Tahsildar office.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must be a Maharashtra resident
rules.remedy_template: Obtain a Maharashtra domicile certificate.

rules.rule_description: Minimum matriculation passed; must be pursuing post-matric education
rules.remedy_template: The scholarship applies to education beyond matriculation.

rules.rule_description: Family annual income must be Rs 2,50,000 or below
rules.remedy_template: Obtain an income certificate confirming family income within Rs 2.5 lakh.

schemes.scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship to VJNT Students - Maharashtra
schemes.department_name: Department of VJNT, SBC and Special Welfare, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.description: Post-matric financial assistance to Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) students of Maharashtra pursuing approved courses.
schemes.benefit_description: Maintenance allowance and fee reimbursement as per state norms for eligible VJNT students.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must belong to a Vimukta Jati / Nomadic Tribe
rules.remedy_template: Obtain a VJNT caste certificate from the Tahsildar office.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must be a Maharashtra resident
rules.remedy_template: Obtain a Maharashtra domicile certificate.

rules.rule_description: Must be pursuing a post-matric approved course
rules.remedy_template: The scholarship applies to approved post-matric courses.

rules.rule_description: Family annual income must be Rs 2,50,000 or below
rules.remedy_template: Obtain an income certificate confirming family income within Rs 2.5 lakh.

schemes.scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship to SBC Students - Maharashtra
schemes.department_name: Department of VJNT, SBC and Special Welfare, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.description: Post-matric financial assistance to Special Backward Class (SBC) students of Maharashtra pursuing approved courses, with attendance requirements.
schemes.benefit_description: Maintenance allowance and fee reimbursement as per state norms; 75% attendance required.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must belong to the Special Backward Class
rules.remedy_template: Obtain an SBC caste certificate from the Tahsildar office.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must be a Maharashtra resident
rules.remedy_template: Obtain a Maharashtra domicile certificate.

rules.rule_description: Must be pursuing a post-matric approved course
rules.remedy_template: The scholarship applies to approved post-matric courses.

rules.rule_description: Family annual income must be Rs 2,50,000 or below
rules.remedy_template: Obtain an income certificate confirming family income within Rs 2.5 lakh.

schemes.scheme_name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses (Minority Students)
schemes.department_name: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India
schemes.description: Scholarship for students from notified minority communities pursuing professional and technical undergraduate and postgraduate courses, including B.E./B.Tech engineering disciplines.
schemes.benefit_description: Course-fee support and monthly maintenance allowance for eligible minority students in professional/technical courses.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must belong to a notified minority community
rules.remedy_template: Obtain a minority-community declaration/certificate as applicable.

rules.rule_description: Must have scored at least 50% in the previous final examination (12th standard)
rules.remedy_template: The merit-cum-means scholarship requires 50% or more marks in the previous qualifying examination.

rules.rule_description: Must be pursuing a professional or technical course at eligible institutions
rules.remedy_template: The scholarship covers professional/technical UG-PG courses (B.E./B.Tech included).

rules.rule_description: Family annual income must be Rs 2,50,000 or below
rules.remedy_template: Obtain an income certificate confirming family income within Rs 2.5 lakh.

schemes.scheme_name: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship for College and University Students
schemes.department_name: Ministry of Education, Government of India
schemes.description: Central Sector merit scholarship for students above the 80th percentile in Class XII pursuing regular degree courses, with family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh.
schemes.benefit_description: Fixed monthly scholarship amount paid for the duration of the regular degree course.

rules.rule_description: Must be above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the Class XII stream/board
rules.remedy_template: PM-USP requires above the 80th percentile in Class XII; check your board percentile.

rules.rule_description: Must be pursuing a regular degree course (diploma-only students are not eligible)
rules.remedy_template: The scholarship applies to regular degree courses after Class XII.

rules.rule_description: Family annual income must be Rs 4,50,000 or below
rules.remedy_template: Obtain an income certificate confirming family income within Rs 4.5 lakh.

schemes.scheme_name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
schemes.department_name: All India Council for Technical Education
schemes.description: AICTE scholarship for girl students in the first year of a degree or diploma at AICTE-approved institutions, with family income up to Rs 8 lakh (two girls per family).
schemes.benefit_description: Rs 50,000 per annum for tuition and contingency support, selected on qualifying-examination merit.

rules.rule_description: Scheme is exclusively for girl students
rules.remedy_template: Pragati is only for female students in technical education.

rules.rule_description: Must be in the first year of an AICTE-approved degree/diploma
rules.remedy_template: Admission through a centralized process to an AICTE-approved institution is required.

rules.rule_description: Family annual income must be Rs 8,00,000 or below
rules.remedy_template: Obtain an income certificate confirming family income within Rs 8 lakh.

schemes.scheme_name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Differently-Abled Students
schemes.department_name: All India Council for Technical Education
schemes.description: AICTE scholarship for differently-abled students pursuing degree or diploma courses at AICTE-approved institutions.
schemes.benefit_description: Rs 50,000 per annum covering tuition and contingency support for eligible differently-abled technical students.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must have a documented disability (disability certificate, 40% or above)
rules.remedy_template: A disability certificate from a competent medical authority is required.

rules.rule_description: Must be pursuing a degree or diploma at an AICTE-approved institution
rules.remedy_template: Enrollment at an AICTE-approved technical institution is required.

schemes.scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Persons with Disabilities - Maharashtra
schemes.department_name: Department of Social Justice and Special Assistance, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.description: Post-matric financial assistance to students with 40% or more disability in Maharashtra pursuing education at recognized institutions.
schemes.benefit_description: Maintenance allowance and fee reimbursement as per state norms for eligible students with disabilities.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must have a disability of 40% or above (disability certificate required)
rules.remedy_template: A disability certificate showing 40% or more disability is required.

rules.rule_description: Applicant must be a Maharashtra resident
rules.remedy_template: Obtain a Maharashtra domicile certificate.

rules.rule_description: Must be pursuing post-matric education at a recognized institution
rules.remedy_template: The scholarship applies to post-matric courses at recognized institutions.
